SUMMARY
Supply chain leader with 15 years in manufacturing and distribution, the last five running
planning, purchasing and logistics for a $480 million packaging business. I build planning
processes people actually follow, and I've cut inventory without hurting service at three
companies. Looking for a senior supply chain role with a growing manufacturer.
EXPERIENCE
Tennwick Packaging Supply Minneapolis, MN
Director of Supply Chain Feb 2021 – Present
• Lead planning, purchasing, warehousing and transportation for four plants, with a team of
46 and $210 million in annual spend
• Cut inventory by $18 million in two years while raising order fill rate from 93% to 98%
• Set up a monthly sales and operations planning meeting that sales, finance and plant leaders
run together, with one shared forecast
• Moved 60% of freight to two carriers under new contracts, saving $2.6 million a year
• Led supplier recovery through the 2021 and 2022 resin shortages, with no missed customer
shipments and no air freight
• Opened a third-party warehouse in Dallas to serve southern customers, cutting delivery times
from four days to two
Lakeport Components St. Paul, MN
Senior Supply Chain Manager Mar 2017 – Jan 2021
• Ran demand and supply planning for 4,000 parts sold to equipment makers
• Moved planning from spreadsheets to an advanced planning system; forecast accuracy rose
from 61% to 78% in a year
• Built a supplier scorecard for the top 40 suppliers and cut late deliveries by half
• Managed a planning team of nine and promoted three planners into supervisor roles
• Worked with engineering to retire 700 slow-moving parts
Gorseholt Distribution Eagan, MN
